Subject: Request: evidence map + audit cadence for 3PA review

Hi Mina,

Thanks for taking this on. Arcadia is starting a 3PA compliance intake for an upcoming procurement window and we need a consolidated evidence package and a short roadmap for external auditors. High level asks:

- Current SOC 2 status (Type II latest report date and scope)
- SIG/CAIQ completed responses or access to a completed questionnaire
- ISO 27001 plans: do you have a timeline for certification or a gap analysis?
- FedRAMP posture: any formal readiness level or ATO path (e.g., JAB, P-ATO timeline)?
- Data retention and export controls for customer-managed VPCs and Private deployments

Would also appreciate a proposed mutual action plan (milestones & dates) so we can align procurement and our security review. Ideally we get an initial package this week and a follow-up call early next week.

Can you confirm what you can share now and an estimated delivery date for the rest? We will need contact points for control owners (encryption, incident response, access management).

Thanks,
James Sullivan
Head of Vendor Risk, Arcadia Health
security@arcadiahealth.com

Note: we will accept redacted SOC2 and completed SIG; CAIQ is preferred in spreadsheet form.

James — thanks for the clear list. Looping in our security and product leads to assemble the package. Quick notes and a proposed plan below.

What we can share now (redacted or summary):
- SOC 2 Type II (report + control owner list): redacted PDF available (we will include scope and testing period).
- SIG: completed matrix (xlsx) — we can export the latest responses and provide an owner for each control.
- CAIQ: we have a completed CAIQ export; will include in the package.
- ISO 27001: we are not currently certified. We do have a formal gap analysis and a phased roadmap to certification (Q4 2026 target for external audit readiness).
- FedRAMP: we do not have a P-ATO. We maintain a FedRAMP-aligned control set and can provide a readiness summary, control mapping, and a recommended path for an Impact Level assessment.
- VPC/Private: network architecture, KMS integration details, and data retention policies for customer-managed deployments are available.

Proposed mutual action plan (draft):
1) 2026-05-06: Initial evidence packet delivered (redacted SOC2, SIG spreadsheet, CAIQ export, iso_gap_analysis_plan).
2) 2026-05-10: Pre-audit alignment call (security + procurement) to walk key controls and dependencies.
3) 2026-05-20: Follow-up with any deep-dive evidence (logs, configuration snapshots, architecture diagrams).
4) 2026-06-15: Coordinate vendor assessment window / remote audit if needed.

Open items for our side: please confirm the list of controls you want prioritized in the deep-dive and whether you require on-site reviewers or will operate remotely.

Karthik / Neha / Olga — can you confirm delivery commitments for the items below? I will assemble the packet and push to a shared Drive folder.

Thanks,
Mina
